title: Germany Faces Twin Pressures as Russia Drone Blame and Economic Stagnation… · 02 Sep
keywords: Germany, Russia, hybrid warfare, drone incident, Leipzig/Halle, German economy, inflation, HICP, economic reform, critical infrastructure, European security, EU economy, Berlin, diplomatic retaliation, cost of living
notes: Berlin has publicly linked a suspected drone incident at Leipzig/Halle airport to Russia, raising the spectre of hybrid warfare on German soil while the government simultaneously struggles to convince voters that an economic recovery is underway. The two crises, one rooted in national security and the other in household finances, are converging at a politically sensitive moment. Together they are testing whether the German government can project stability at home and credibility abroad.
